scenario: Firing order is fully determined by the inputs per LDET.4.2 — same fact stream always produces same activation order. Pin: assert same three facts in the same order on two separate engines; both produce the same rule_fire_order sequence.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule ra:
    A a where a.v == 1
->
    log info "ra"

rule rb:
    A a where a.v == 2
->
    log info "rb"

rule rc:
    A a where a.v == 3
->
    log info "rc"
